entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, bear with me. I think this is making sense. I think that Angela and Wallace Schiff... Were digested by that substance that I found all over that field. That they were dissolved and then expelled up out of the ground. What if that substance... And this hallucinogen are from one and the same organism?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: A giant mushroom?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: A giant fungal organism, Mulder. We already know that they exist. Biologists have found specimens that range dozens of acres... That weigh hundreds of tons. And what if this one needs to feed on living tissue? There is carnivorous Plant life. There's the venus flytrap and the pitcher Plant. Mulder, what if this one puts off a hallucinogen--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: To lure its prey into the cave?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: To make it complacent-- to keep it still while it devours it.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ gasps ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: What if we're still underground, Mulder? What if we're moving deeper into the cave, or being moved? Mulder, what if we're being digested? Right now.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: [ coughing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: The exact size of this organism has yet to be determined?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: That's correct, sir. We know that the organism extends for at least ten acres. Though it's mostly subterranean, so it may be far larger.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We've contacted fish and wildlife. We've contacted the north carolina state health department... As well as the local FBI field office in raleigh. And we've contacted a mycologist at the smithsonian for good measure. We think we have our bases covered.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The lab results determined that the spores we were exposed to... Have a chemical structure similar to l.s.d. They also contain an alkaloid which induces a state of narcosis.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: It's a rare day when the two of you sign off on the same report. Agent Mulder?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I'm just thinking. Uh, I'm not exactly clear on how we escaped.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: What's not clear?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Once you recognized we were under a chemical influence, then it simply kind of... Broke its spell?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's right.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Scully, how could we simply... Will ourselves out of a chemical hallucination?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Well, the fact remains we did.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Did we? Can you name me one drug that loses its effect once the user realizes it's in his system?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I assume the effects wore off to the point you were able to make your escape.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: How long were we underground-- hours, half a day? How come our bodies don't show effects of being burned by the digestive fluids? We were covered in hydrochloric acid, yet look at our skin. Nothing.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Agent Mulder, where are you going with this?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Scully, we never escaped. We're still trapped underground.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder, we did escape. I think you're suffering from post-traumatic stress.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No, I'm not. This is not real. You-- you're not real.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: [ scoffs ] Mulder, I--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'll prove it, Scully. I'll prove it.
